# CardVariant

`Flare.Components.CardVariant`

Visual style of a FlareCard, independent of the active theme. Each theme reskins the variants through its CardTokens, so a variant looks native everywhere (e.g. Tonal is a soft secondary-container fill). The five names mirror ButtonVariant (Filled/Outlined/Text/Elevated/Tonal).

## Values

| Name | Value | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `Filled` | `0` | Solid container tinted from the surface scale. |
| `Outlined` | `1` | Bordered container with no elevation. |
| `Text` | `2` | Transparent container with no border or shadow, only a hover wash. |
| `Elevated` | `3` | Surface container lifted by a drop shadow. The default. |
| `Tonal` | `4` | Soft tonal container using the secondary-container color. |

## Used by components

- `FlareCard`
